title: Zephaniah Bible Quiz - Chapter 2
description: Ten questions on Zephaniah 2: the call to seek Yahweh, the word against the sea coast and Moab, and Nineveh laid waste.

questions.text: Whom does verse 3 tell to seek Yahweh?
questions.explanation: Zephaniah 2:3 says, "Seek Yahweh, all you humble of the land, who have kept his ordinances."

answers.text: All the kings of the earth
All the humble of the land

questions.text: Besides Yahweh himself, what two things does verse 3 tell them to seek?
questions.explanation: Zephaniah 2:3 says to seek righteousness and to seek humility, so that they may be hidden in the day of Yahweh's anger.

questions.text: What does verse 4 say will happen to Gaza?
questions.explanation: Zephaniah 2:4 says Gaza will be forsaken and Ashkelon a desolation.

answers.text: It will be given to Moab
It will be filled with people

questions.text: Which city will they drive out at noonday?
questions.explanation: Zephaniah 2:4 says they will drive out Ashdod at noonday, and Ekron will be rooted up.

questions.text: Which nation of the sea coast is addressed with woe?
questions.explanation: Zephaniah 2:5 says woe to the inhabitants of the sea coast, the nation of the Cherethites.

questions.text: What will the sea coast become, according to verse 6?
questions.explanation: Zephaniah 2:6 says the sea coast will be pastures, with cottages for shepherds and folds for flocks.

answers.text: A desert of sand and stone
A harbor full of trading ships
A field of vines and olives

questions.text: Which city does Yahweh say Moab will be like?
questions.explanation: Zephaniah 2:9 says that surely Moab will be as Sodom, and the children of Ammon as Gomorrah.

questions.text: What does verse 11 say Yahweh will do to the gods of the land?
questions.explanation: Zephaniah 2:11 says Yahweh will be awesome to them, for he will famish all the gods of the land.

questions.text: Which city will he make a desolation, as dry as the wilderness?
questions.explanation: Zephaniah 2:13 says he will stretch out his hand against the north, destroy Assyria and make Nineveh a desolation.

questions.text: What did the joyous city say in her heart?
questions.explanation: Zephaniah 2:15 says the joyous city that lived carelessly said in her heart, "I am, and there is no one besides me."

answers.text: My walls will never be broken
The gods have made me great
I am, and there is no one besides me
